derivation: For fixed-face ideal columns a,b, S=|a|²+|b|²=(2/3)*saved edge-square-sum and T=|a×b|²=(4/3)*saved cross-square. Write c=sqrt(3/2)*(p-centroid), w=normal(c)², r=tangent(c)², u=w+r. The cofactor norm squared is T+S*w+nonnegative tangential terms.
Q²<=9*T*w/[(S+u)*(T+S*w)]<=9*T*u/[(S+u)*(T+S*u)] because w<=u and w/(T+S*w) increases. Q>=1/10 requires S*u²+(S²-899*T)*u+S*T<=0. Saved exact q_face²=4*T/S²>=4/841 gives positive roots.

u<=u+<sum of positive roots=(899*T-S²)/S. Thus all feasible physical apices lie inside the rational centroid ball with squared radius U=(2/3)*(899*T/S-S). For two such balls and exact centroid distance squared D, D>U+V and (D-U-V)²>4*U*V certifies strict disjointness. No square root/tolerance/grid is used.
